race.comment: WOLF JUNIOR (2) looks well placed here to find winning form. Fresh-up after a long break found the line strongly but also found one better. Placed 2/2 course and distance and should go close. FIERCE 'N FABULOUS (4) was thereabouts in a Class 2 last time and best form stacks up. Back a grade and change of rider. Blinkers added and looks a terrific chance to return to form. NANDI CLAN (6) is overdue for a win. Placed on the turf over a similar distance last time. Sure to go close. COLONEL BOGEY (3) is racing well and with the claim is one of the better chances. KNIGHTS REIGN (5) can hit the frame with the right run.
